services.value: Anatek Labs provides full service environmental analytical testing, including drinking water, private well water, public drinking water, lead & copper, wastewater/soil/compost testing, hazardous waste testing, pesticide & herbicide testing, PFAS testing, and food/beverage/microbiology testing. For food pathogen testing, it offers testing within specified timeframes and tests for pathogens such as Listeria, Salmonella, and E. coli 0157:H7.
